responsibility: This file coordinates mc’s end-to-end compilation process. It identifies the compilation unit kind, preprocesses and opens source files, locates companion definition or implementation modules via mcSearch, drives passes mcp1 through mcp5 with the correct module-opening policy and visitation control, handles extended-opaque recompilation of hidden implementation types, flushes diagnostics between passes, and finally invokes decl.out to emit translated output. It is the pass scheduler and module-loading orchestrator for the mc front end.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation body for the mcComp stem, coordinating preprocessing, module discovery, pass wrappers, file opening, visitation, and final output, while the same-named .def file exposes only the top-level entry points.
